svg.title: Full hub pipeline: encoders, hub construction, entry maps, caption head, zero-shot transfer
svg.desc: DFD-style diagram showing the complete hub flow from raw encoder outputs through PCA whitening to the caption head, with frozen components marked and math annotations for each step.
svg.text: STEP 1 — build hub (train rows only, frozen after)
STEP 2 — fit entry maps (one per encoder, closed-form)
STEP 3 — fit caption head (DINOv2-small only, frozen after)
STEP 5 — adding a new encoder (hub + head untouched)

g.text: Hub construction — 8,533 train rows, FROZEN after fitting
3. PCA (SVD): Z = UΣVᵀ → keep top 512 components V₅₁₂ ∈ ℝ^{6144×512}
4. Whiten: H = Z V₅₁₂ Σ₅₁₂⁻¹ → H ∈ ℝ^{8533×512} unit-variance per direction
Hub width must stay below source's algebraic rank (E.8) — 512 < 768 ✓
Hub basis V₅₁₂ and Σ₅₁₂ frozen. All subsequent steps use them read-only.
Entry maps — one per encoder, closed-form ridge regression
For each encoder k with cached vectors Xₖ ∈ ℝ^{n×dₖ} and hub H ∈ ℝ^{n×512}:
Closed form: Wₖ = (XₖᵀXₖ + αI)⁻¹ Xₖᵀ H Wₖ ∈ ℝ^{dₖ×512}
Each map fitted independently — adding one encoder touches no other map.
α = 1e-2. Rows per dim: 8533/dₖ = 9.1–5.6, above the ≥5 pre-registered floor.
Caption head — trained on DINOv2-small only, FROZEN after
Hub vectors of img_small: H_small ∈ ℝ^{8533×512} Target: T_bge ∈ ℝ^{8533×1024}
W_head = (H_smallᵀ H_small + λI)⁻¹ H_smallᵀ T_bge W_head ∈ ℝ^{512×1024}
Head never sees img_base, img_large, GPT-2, SBERT, ConvNeXt — any of them.
Zero-shot transfer — head and hub frozen, entry map frozen per encoder
For any source encoder k (never seen by the head):
1. Map to hub: hⱼ = xⱼᵏ Wₖ (entry map, closed-form, already fitted)
2. Apply head: t̂ⱼ = hⱼ W_head (head frozen — zero-shot step)
3. Retrieve: sⱼ = ⟨q, t̂ⱼ⟩ / (‖q‖‖t̂ⱼ‖) rank by cosine in bge space
img_base 96.5% of native · img_large 92.9% · SigLIP 94.2% · ConvNeXt 96.7%
Control (random entry map): 0.001 = chance. What is zero-shot: the HEAD, not the entry map.
1. Get representations: X_new ∈ ℝ^{9533×1024} (same items, cached)
3. Fit entry map: W_new = (X̃_newᵀ X̃_new + αI)⁻¹ X̃_newᵀ H W_new ∈ ℝ^{1024×512}
4. Use immediately with the frozen head. Hub unchanged. All other maps unchanged.
ConvNeXt result: 96.7% of native, ABOVE the within-family band (93-96.5%). One solve.
